These are the most exciting Super Bowl 2026 trailers!

Quick trailer roundup: Super Mario Galaxy movie (arriving in April), Minions 3 as the next family box office machine, and Steven Spielberg returning to extraterrestrials with Disclosure Day. 

We’re expecting another Disclosure Day trailer/clip, and the big curiosity is whether Spielberg finally reveals more of the aliens without giving the movie away.
